sn55.17:1.1: Ye bhikkhave anukampeyyātha || ye ca sotabbam maññeyyum mittā vā amaccā vā ñātīvā sālohitā vā || te vo bhikkhave catusu sotāpattiyaṅgesu samādapetabbā nivesetabbā patiṭṭhāpetabbā ||
sn55.17:1.4: Iti pi so Bhagavā || la-pe || satthā devamanussānam buddho bhagavā ti || ||
sn55.17:2.1: Siyā bhikkhave catunnam mahābhūtānam aññathattam pathavīdhatuyā āpodhātuyā tejodhātuyā vāyodhātuyā || na tveva Buddhe aveccappasādenasamannāgatassa ariyasāvakassa siyā aññathattaṃ ||
sn55.17:2.2: tatridam aññathattaṃ || || So vata Buddhe aveccappasādena samannāgato ariyasāvako nirayaṃ vā tiracchānayonim vā pittivisayaṃ vā upapajjissatī ti || netaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati || || 5--6.
sn55.17:2.5: Ariyakantesu sīlesu samādapetabbā nivesetabbā patiṭṭhapetabbā || akhaṇḍesu || la-pe || samādhisaṃvattanikesu || ||
sn55.17:2.6: Siyā bhikkhave catunnam mahābhūtānam aññathattam pathavidhatuyā āpo- tejo- vāyodhātuyā || na tveva ariyakantehi sīlehi samannāgatassa ariyasāvakassa siyā aññathattam ||
sn55.17:2.7: tatridam aññathattam || || So vata ariyakantehi sīlehi samannāgato ariyasāvako nirayaṃ vā tiracchānayoniṃ vā pittivisayaṃ vā uppajjissatī ti netaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati || || 8.
sn55.17:2.8: Ye bhikkhave anukampeyyātha || ye ca sotabbam maññeyyum mittā vā amaccā vā ñatī vā sālohitā vā || te vo bhikkhave imesu catusu sotāpattiyaṅgesu samādapetabbā nivesetabbā patiṭṭhāpetabbā
